caption: The video showcases an extreme close-up of a fluid surface, with magenta and red tones dominating the upper region and vivid green the lower, divided by a vertical teal-green band through the center. A fine granular texture of countless tiny light-reflecting speckles covers the surface, while a few small dark spots sit near the top edge, appearing largely stationary. The central teal band slowly morphs in shape and width, its upper tip extending and retracting slightly. Patches of pink and magenta in the upper-left undulate, shifting their boundary with the teal zone and expanding and contracting locally. The lower green region shows faint swirling streaks that drift slowly, deforming the green and teal edge while the green mass stays within view. The glittery speckle texture continuously twinkles and rearranges at a fine scale everywhere. The visible motion consists of slow reshaping and shimmering of the color fields.
relations: The central teal band shifts width and tip length as adjacent magenta and green fields press inward.
Upper-left pink patches undulate, expanding and contracting against the teal boundary while staying out of the green zone.
Lower green streaks drift slowly, deforming the green-teal edge while the green mass remains within frame.
Fine light-reflecting speckles twinkle and rearrange continuously across every color region.
